name: PDF Tools
title: PDF Tools — Merge, Split, Rotate, Compress | ToolsKit
description: Free PDF tools: merge, split, rotate and compress PDF files, and convert between PDF and images. Runs in your browser.
intro: Free online tools for merging, splitting, rotating, compressing and converting PDF files.
faq: Is there a file size limit?
ToolsKit rejects single files over 150 MB. The practical limit depends on your device’s memory, and phones may struggle with large files.
Why did my PDF not get smaller?
Compress PDF re-saves the file more efficiently but does not recompress the images inside it, so photo-heavy PDFs may barely change.
Can I use password-protected PDFs?
No. Remove the password first, then add the file.
How do I choose which pages to extract?
In Split PDF, type page numbers like 1-3,5.
card: Merge, split, rotate, compress and convert PDF files.

faq: Which formats can I use?
Anything your browser can open as an image, such as JPG, PNG or WebP. Output formats are JPEG, PNG or WebP depending on the tool.
Why is a compressed image not smaller?
Images that are already well compressed may not shrink further. Each tool shows the real result size.
